title: Amma's (Jan's) Oreo Cookie Cake
description: A no-bake layered dessert with crushed Oreos, cream cheese filling, chocolate pudding, and whipped topping.

steps.instruction: Crush Oreo cookies into small chunks using a rolling pin or similar tool.
Mix crushed Oreos with melted butter until combined.
Press half of the mixture into the bottom of a dish to form a crust.
In a bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth.
Gently fold in the whipped topping.
Spread the cream cheese mixture over the Oreo crust.
Prepare chocolate pudding according to package instructions using cold milk.
Pour pudding evenly over the cream layer.
Sprinkle remaining Oreo mixture on top.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
